## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

RaceLaunchController — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/race/RaceLaunchController.kt

## Trigger

`launch` and `retryAndLaunch`, at the point they call `recordingRepository.startClock(...)` — observed

## Today

`raceTicker.start()` is called only from
`ExerciseSessionManager.registerReadingsAndStartTicker()`
(`ExerciseSessionManager.kt:87-90`), itself reached only from
`ExerciseSessionManager.open()` on the `Started` or `AlreadyOwned`
outcomes (`:36-46`). `RaceLaunchController.launch` and
`retryAndLaunch` call `recordingRepository.startClock(...)`
(`RaceLaunchController.kt:52-53`, `:60-62`) without ever calling
`exerciseSessionManager.open()` themselves for `launch`, and
`retryAndLaunch` discards the outcome of the `open()` it does call
(`:61`) and starts the clock regardless. When `system.startExerciseSession()`
returns `Failed`, `open()` returns `ExerciseSessionOpenResult.Failed`,
`registerReadingsAndStartTicker()` is never reached, and
`raceTicker.start()` never runs — yet the clock starts and the race is
recorded in the store with `lastKnownNow` never advancing.
Symmetrically, `raceTicker.stop()` sits inside
`ExerciseSessionManager.close()` (`:59-68`), reached from
`StopRaceController.stop()` only `result.onSuccess` after
`recordingRepository.stopRace(...)` (`StopRaceController.kt:28-29`) and
from `EndOfRaceViewModel` (`:47`) — so today the ticker's stop is tied
to the session's close, not directly to the race's own end.
`RaceLaunchController` is built by
`RaceControllerModule.provideRaceLaunchController`
(`di/RaceControllerModule.kt:30-33`) with `recordingRepository` and
`exerciseSessionManager` only; it holds no reference to `RaceTicker`
today.

## Expected

`RaceLaunchController.launch` and `retryAndLaunch` start `raceTicker`
at the same point they call `recordingRepository.startClock(...)`,
independently of `exerciseSessionManager.open()`'s outcome, so the
clock ticks whether or not the exercise session opened. This requires
`RaceLaunchController` to receive a `RaceTicker` (a second gap:
`RaceControllerModule.provideRaceLaunchController` must be given a
`RaceTicker` argument to pass to the constructor, the same one
`SensorModule` already provides to `ExerciseSessionManager`).
`registerReadingsAndStartTicker()` no longer starts the ticker — it
only registers `readingsSource` — and `raceTicker.start()` is removed
from `ExerciseSessionManager.open()`'s two success branches. `raceTicker.stop()`
moves out of `ExerciseSessionManager.close()` and is called wherever the
race itself ends — alongside `recordingRepository.stopRace(...)` in
`StopRaceController.stop()` — rather than as a side effect of the
session closing, so the two remain paired the same way `startClock`
and the ticker start now are.
